title: Distributed UAV Swarm Collaborative SLAM Based on Visual-Inertial-Ranging Measurement
authors: Shou Y.; Song Z.; Qi H.; Li Z.; Chen W.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
